box-sizing: border-box; height: auto !important; min-height: max(34vh, 260px) !important; padding: calc(var(--nav-height,88px) + 1.5rem) 1.25rem 2rem !important;

styles.css: @font-face { font-family: Montserrat; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500 800; font-display: swap; src: url("assets/fonts/montserrat-latin-ext.woff2") format("woff2"); unicode-range: U+100-2BA, U+2BD-2C5, U+2C7-2CC, U+2CE-2D7, U+2DD-2FF, U+304, U+308, U+329, U+1D00-1DBF, U+1E00-1E9F, U+1EF2-1EFF, U+2020, U+20A0-20AB, U+20AD-20C4, U+2113, U+2C60-2C7F, U+A720-A7FF; }

@font-face { font-family: Montserrat; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500 800; font-display: swap; src: url("assets/fonts/montserrat-latin.woff2") format("woff2"); unicode-range: U+0-FF, U+131, U+152-153, U+2BB-2BC, U+2C6, U+2DA, U+2DC, U+304, U+308, U+329, U+2000-206F, U+20AC, U+2122, U+2191, U+2193, U+2212, U+2215, U+FEFF, U+FFFD; }
body { margin: 0px; font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
nav { position: absolute; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; z-index: 1000; background: transparent; transition: background 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s; }
body.toc-sub h2 { color: rgb(0, 55, 85); margin: 1.4rem 0px 1rem; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.2rem); }
body.toc-sub h3 { color: rgb(0, 156, 222); margin: 0px 0px 0.4rem; font-size: 1.25rem; }
body.toc-sub .ws-grid, body.toc-sub .grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(7, 16, 24); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
html.dark .card-band .card, html.dark body.toc-sub .ps-card, html.dark body.toc-sub .w-card { background: rgb(15, 27, 38); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 10px 28px; }

html.dark .card-band h2, html.dark .card-band h3, html.dark body.toc-sub h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h3, html.dark .mission-block h2, html.dark .ps-card h3, html.dark .breadcrumb [aria-current] { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }

html.dark .stat-label, html.dark .stat-source, html.dark .ps-card small, html.dark .ps-note, html.dark .mw-date, html.dark .mw-note, html.dark .mw-status, html.dark .mw-count small { color: rgb(159, 179, 196); opacity: 1; }
html.dark .breadcrumb a, html.dark .next-solutions a { color: rgb(143, 211, 255); border-color: rgb(143, 211, 255); }
.breadcrumb ol { list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.35rem; }

nav.breadcrumb, body.toc-sub nav.breadcrumb, body.toc-home nav.breadcrumb, nav.jump-nav, body.toc-sub nav.jump-nav { position: static; background: none; box-shadow: none; z-index: auto; border: 0px; backdrop-filter: none; }
body.toc-home, body.toc-sub { font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: var(--toc-navy); }
.skip-link { position: absolute; left: -9999px; top: 0px; background: var(--toc-navy); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 0.6rem 1rem; z-index: 2000; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }

body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav { position: fixed; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; background: rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.35); backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); box-shadow: none; z-index: 1000; transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s, border-color 0.3s; }
body.toc-sub .w-card { padding: 1.2rem; background: rgb(0, 55, 85); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 55, 85, 0.15) 0px 8px 22px; }
body.toc-sub .w-card p { color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.6; }
body.toc-sub .impact-box { background: rgb(0, 55, 85); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-radius: 10px; padding: 1.6rem 1.8rem; box-shadow: rgba(0, 55, 85, 0.15) 0px 8px 22px; }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(11, 18, 32); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
html.dark .w-card, html.dark .card, html.dark .dropdown-menu { background: rgb(21, 32, 51); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }

styles.css: @font-face { font-family: Montserrat; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500 800; font-display: swap; src: url("assets/fonts/montserrat-latin-ext.woff2") format("woff2"); unicode-range: U+100-2BA, U+2BD-2C5, U+2C7-2CC, U+2CE-2D7, U+2DD-2FF, U+304, U+308, U+329, U+1D00-1DBF, U+1E00-1E9F, U+1EF2-1EFF, U+2020, U+20A0-20AB, U+20AD-20C4, U+2113, U+2C60-2C7F, U+A720-A7FF; }

@font-face { font-family: Montserrat; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500 800; font-display: swap; src: url("assets/fonts/montserrat-latin.woff2") format("woff2"); unicode-range: U+0-FF, U+131, U+152-153, U+2BB-2BC, U+2C6, U+2DA, U+2DC, U+304, U+308, U+329, U+2000-206F, U+20AC, U+2122, U+2191, U+2193, U+2212, U+2215, U+FEFF, U+FFFD; }
body { margin: 0px; font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
nav { position: absolute; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; z-index: 1000; background: transparent; transition: background 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s; }

body { margin: 0px; font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }

body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav { position: fixed; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; background: rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.35); backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); box-shadow: none; z-index: 1000; transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s, border-color 0.3s; }

.card-band h3 a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }

.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help { backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(180%); text-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 1px 2px; border-radius: 999px !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; background: linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.22),rgba(255,255,255,.06)),var(--lg-tint) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) 0px 1px 0px inset, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 0px -1px 0px inset, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28) 0px 6px 20px !important; }
.sol-filters { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.6rem; align-items: center; margin: 1rem 0px; }

@media (prefers-contrast: more){.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn, .aud-icon, .eli10-icon, .share-btn, .nav-toggle, .edu-bubble.glass, .t-chip, .dt-btn { border: 2px solid rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; box-shadow: none !important; }}

html body .lw nav:not(#topnav) { background: none; box-shadow: none; z-index: auto; backdrop-filter: none; height: auto; position: static !important; }

html body nav#topnav { top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; z-index: 1000; position: fixed !important; height: auto !important; background: transparent !important; backdrop-filter: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; border: 0px !important; transition: background-color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s !important; }

html body nav#topnav::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0px 0px -28px; background: linear-gradient(rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.72), rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.35) 70%, rgba(0, 20, 40, 0)); pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.3s; z-index: -1; }

#topnav .spn { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0px auto; padding: 8px clamp(12px, 2.2vw, 32px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition: padding 0.3s; }

@media (min-width: 1140px){#topnav .spn { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0px, 1fr); gap: 0px 1rem; }#topnav .spn-panel { display: contents; }#topnav .spn-brand { grid-area: 1 / 1; min-height: 32px; }#topnav .spn-util { grid-area: 1 / 2; justify-self: end; }#topnav .spn-main { grid-area: 2 / 1 / auto / -1; justify-self: end; }}

#topnav .spn-ls-k { position: absolute; top: 2px; inset-inline-start: 2px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 1px 3px; transform: translateX(var(--spn-x)); transition: transform 0.2s; }

#topnav .spn-sub { position: absolute; top: 100%; inset-inline-start: 0px; min-width: 240px; background: rgb(15, 27, 38); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 14px 34px; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transform: translateY(-4px); transition: opacity 0.18s, transform 0.18s, visibility linear 0.18s; z-index: 5; margin-top: 6px !important; padding: 4px 0px !important; }

#topnav a:focus-visible, #topnav button:focus-visible { outline-offset: 2px; outline: rgb(143, 211, 255) solid 2px !important; }
